text: Select: metabolism.met_id, metabolism.met_conversion, metabolism.pathway_key, metabolism.enzyme_name, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS substrate_chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name AS substrate_name, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, compound_records.compound_name. Source: metabolism. Join: Join compound_records on metabolism.substrate_record_id = compound_records.record_id. Join molecule_dictionary on compound_records.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno. Left Join compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: metabolism.tax_id = 9615. Sort: metabolism.met_id ascending. Limit: 200.
